scope: Authenticated project-owned synthetic train/dev representation and V43 dev geometry only

evidence.use: Authoritative train/dev source, manifest, image, and generator-profile binding
V43 runtime raw detector regions in original source pixels
Frozen V2 aggregate geometry and historical full-OCR diagnostics
Bound string-free synthetic truth and 37 panel projections
892 source-pixel boxes and generator roles without text strings
Frozen family assignment, renderer-profile coupling, presentation, and seeded degradation selection
V43 fixed-panel training loop and absence of training-time representation augmentation

measured_gap.generator_constraint: Each renderer selects one fixed font, degradation, template, and marker profile. The two train combinations and one dev combination therefore confound all five axes.
measured_gap.training_variation_constraint: V40 through V43 reuse 20 cached source graphs and 28 immutable panels. The training loop changes draw order only and performs no image or feature augmentation.
measured_gap.seed_constraint: A source seed selects only one to two degradation kinds and one parameter value per selected kind. Three dev seeds do not independently cover the five representation axes.

truth_geometry_distribution.normalization: Each panel-projected truth box was scaled independently by tensor_width/panel_width and tensor_height/panel_height from the authenticated 37-panel oracle request.

image_statistic_definitions.near_white_fraction: Fraction of grayscale pixels at or above 240 of 255
image_statistic_definitions.gray_standard_deviation: Population standard deviation across all grayscale pixels
image_statistic_definitions.mean_absolute_neighbor_difference: Mean of horizontal and vertical absolute adjacent-pixel differences

dev_source_measurements.visual_observation: Two stacked panels, small monospaced text, grayscale rendering, and compact legends inside the graph area.
One panel, small monospaced text, dense symbolic markers, and a compact multi-line legend inside the graph area.
Six stacked panels, visibly textured gray paper background, repeated compact legends, small monospaced text, and crowded condition captions.

measured: All five family axes have zero train/dev value overlap, and the renderer profile hard-couples those axes. Existing evidence cannot attribute the gap to one family axis.

All three dev sources fail at similar recall, including the two near-white sources. The noisiest source has the highest dev precision and recall. Scan background severity alone therefore does not explain the observed failure.

Raw width is confounded by role, but the normalized within-role comparison identifies two concrete support gaps. Train condition labels reach only 8.53 tensor pixels while 12 dev condition labels are missed with a 39.25-pixel median; train legends reach 91.31 tensor pixels while missed dev legends have a 100.69-pixel median.

Width is not a global explanation. All nine dev participant labels match despite being wider than train participants, phase-heading matched and missed medians are both 74.24 tensor pixels, and missed x ticks are narrower than matched x ticks.
Legend text is the clearest geometry failure at 1 of 11 matched. Condition labels match 18 of 30, and x ticks match 36 of 48.

Of 48 missed truths, 15 have no overlap with any prediction, 9 have best IoU below 0.25, 6 fall from 0.25 through 0.40, and 18 fall from 0.40 through the 0.50 gate. Fifteen misses have a best prediction that intersects multiple truth boxes, consistent with a bounded merge/localization failure subset.

V43 reaches 97.68 percent train precision but only 89.00 percent train recall. The family gap is material evidence, but it cannot explain every remaining train miss or exclude a frozen-feature capacity limit.
diagnosis.working_hypothesis: The fixed 20-source training representation undercovers long condition-label and legend extents. Longer training over the same immutable features fits the two train family bundles without resolving these two held-out geometry modes.
diagnosis.causal_limit: The dev family changes renderer, font, degradation, template, and marker style together. Source-level and generator-role attribution is exact, but the current evidence cannot identify which coupled visual axis causes an individual false positive or false negative.

next_bounded_experiment.name: train-only long condition-label and legend extent coverage
next_bounded_experiment.hypothesis: Adding deterministic long condition labels and legends within existing train-owned families will improve those two dev geometry subsets without importing any dev family or case.
next_bounded_experiment.isolated_change: Change only the train text-value schedule, using a new train-only lexicon salt, so at least 20 of 80 condition labels project to 32-48 detector-tensor pixels and at least 10 of 30 legend labels project to 96-112 detector-tensor pixels. Retain only current train renderer, font, degradation, template, and marker families.
held_fixed: The 20 train source seeds, 28 train panels, canvas sizes, panel/session geometry, non-text graph primitives, and truth-region count
The three authenticated dev sources, their family keys, pixels, truth, and frozen IoU 0.5 scorer
The V43 parent trunk and head initialization, target construction, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, 240 epochs, and train-loss checkpoint selection
The existing 95 percent precision and recall acceptance bars
split_guards: Retain existing train family assignments. Do not import scan_rough, system_mono, scan_noise, compact_legend, symbolic, or any dev seed/source into training.
Generate new training text from an independent project-owned train lexicon; do not copy text from dev examples. Shared generic characters and tokens are not a new exclusion criterion.
Authenticate a new train manifest and prove zero source identities overlap dev before optimization.
Keep checkpoint selection train-only. Dev remains available without a run limit for diagnosis and gate reporting under the shared evidence policy.
required_report: Full train and dev precision, recall, TP, FP, and FN under the unchanged frozen scorer
Dev source-level and generator-role geometry diagnostics using the same string-free truth adapter
Rendered and detector-tensor train width-band counts for condition labels and legend text
Optimizer steps, runtime, manifest hashes, source hashes, and unchanged private/sealed counters

interpretation.if_improved: A dev gain concentrated in condition labels and legend text supports extent undercoverage as a causal contributor. It does not explain x-tick or zero-overlap misses.
interpretation.if_not_improved: Do not extend duration. Treat width support as rejected and investigate compact placement, the other still-confounded family axes, and frozen-feature capacity as separate future hypotheses.

next_bounded_experiment.coverage_note: The proposed width bands define the isolated training-data treatment, not additional accuracy acceptance gates. Verify rendered layout and actual application panel mapping before optimization; report any changed count or overlap rather than silently clipping or discarding examples.

historical_full_ocr_note.scope: Historical V43 frozen-runtime diagnostic only. A later parent-runtime participant-role repair means these role values are not current acceptance evidence.

limitations: No annotation text strings were read. Recognition errors cannot be attributed to individual dev strings from this diagnosis.
The three dev images are one coupled family bundle and are too few to estimate independent renderer, font, degradation, template, or marker effects.
The selected width experiment is a bounded diagnostic for 22 condition-label and legend misses, not a claim that box width explains all 48 false negatives or will clear the unchanged gate.
The image statistics and visual observations describe inputs; they do not establish causality.
No changed renderer output was generated, and no altered image was presented as parity evidence.
The proposed experiment has not been preregistered, implemented, trained, or evaluated.

lead_verification.matcher_source_review: Same fixed-order augmenting-path matching as frozen V2; every unmatched truth has best IoU below 0.5, so unmatched role attribution is not caused by ambiguous match allocation.
lead_verification.policy_clarification: Dev use remains unlimited and shared generic text tokens do not become a new forbidden overlap criterion.
